_readme: DAILY RATES FEED. Leave 'items' empty and the bot will keep telling people to call the branch. When filled, the bot shows rates ONLY if 'updated' is within maxAgeHours; otherwise it hides the numbers and says when they were last published. commodity must be one of: areca, cocoa, pepper, rubber, coconut. Give either price, or min and max. Example item: { "commodity": "areca", "variety": "<variety name>", "unit": "per quintal", "price": 0 }
